## [2.53.1] - 2026-03-01

### Changed

- **Scan-time hash backfill optimization** -- Separated phash computation from backfill processing, limiting to content hash only (~5ms/item). Estimated time for 32,882 NULL hash backfill items reduced from 55 minutes → 3 minutes. phash processed in dedicated compute-hashes job
- **phash computation 460x speedup with numpy DCT** -- Replaced pure Python triple-loop DCT (9.9ms/item) in `helpers_phash_compute.py` with numpy matrix product-based implementation (0.021ms/item). Auto-fallback to pure Python when numpy not installed. Backward compatible (hash values are exact match)
- **Backfill progress logging added** -- Displays NULL hash count at scan start, console output of backfill progress every 200 items, summary at completion. Distinguishes backfill action as `"backfilled"` and added `backfilled` count to `execute_scan_loop` return value

## [2.53.0] - 2026-03-01

### Added

- **DB auto-backup feature** -- WAL-safe online backup via `sqlite3.Connection.backup()`. Create/list/restore/delete core logic in `core/backup_core/`, `BackupScheduler` (threading.Timer) for periodic backups, auto-backup on scan completion (event_bus integration). `.meta.json` sidecar files record reason/schema_version/created_at. Generation management (max_generations) auto-deletes old backups. Cooldown feature prevents duplicate backups
- **Backup management API 5 endpoints** -- `POST /api/tools/backup/create` (manual creation), `GET /api/tools/backup/list` (listing), `POST /api/tools/backup/restore` (restore), `POST /api/tools/backup/delete` (deletion), `GET /api/tools/backup/status` (status). DESTRUCTIVE rate limit applied. Auto-backup before restore, path traversal prevention, SQLite validation (magic bytes + files table + trigger/view rejection)
- **Backup management UI** -- Added "Create Backup" button to Tools page, backup list table (filename/date/size/reason/restore and delete buttons), scheduler state and last backup date display. Existing Download/Restore from File buttons maintained as-is
- **MCP backup tools 4 items** -- `list_backups()`, `create_backup()`, `restore_backup(filename)`, `get_backup_status()`
- **config.json `backup` section** -- 6 settings: `enabled`, `backup_dir`, `max_generations`, `periodic_interval_hours`, `backup_on_scan_complete`, `cooldown_minutes`

### Changed

- **Pre-migration backup delegated to new system** -- `schema_migrate.py`'s `_backup_before_migrate()` uses the new backup system (falls back to traditional `shutil.copy2` on failure)

## [2.52.3] - 2026-03-01

### Changed

- **Scan speed optimization after backfill completion** -- Executes `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM files WHERE is_deleted=0 AND (hash IS NULL OR phash IS NULL)` once at scan start, skipping the entire backfill logic if count is 0. Previously `_backfill_hashes()` was called for every file, with internal phash SELECT queries running even after all hash/phash were filled. Added `needs_backfill()` helper to `core/scan/common.py` and propagated `skip_backfill` flag from `scan_one` to each worker

## [2.52.2] - 2026-03-01

### Fixed

- **Fixed bug where hash=NULL file backfill was not called for not_modified files (BUG-62 complete fix)** -- `_backfill_hashes()` was gated by the `compute_hash` flag, so hash backfill was never executed for not_modified files during normal scanning (compute_hash=False). Since hash backfill is a data integrity repair operation, changed to always execute regardless of `compute_hash` flag. Also added similar backfill logic for ZIP/7z archive members (`_backfill_zip_hash`, `_backfill_7z_hash`) so hash=NULL in archive files will also be automatically filled on next scan

## [2.52.1] - 2026-03-01

### Fixed

- **Fixed scan status persisting after server restart** -- `scan_state.json` persisted across server restarts, causing the banner for previously interrupted scans to continue displaying. Added `clear_scan_state()` call at server startup to clear state. Also added 24-hour auto-expiration logic to `interrupted_scan_payload()` to prevent edge cases of old interrupted states persisting

- **ZIP/7z scan fault tolerance hardening** -- Archives in any state — corrupted (BadZipFile), password-protected (encrypted flag bit), truncated, permission errors, structural anomalies — are now skipped and processing continues. Added password-protected entry filtering, PermissionError/OSError guards on `is_file()` / glob calls, early break for structurally broken ZIPs
- **Added slow entry warning to scan loop** -- Logs when individual file processing exceeds 120 seconds. Timeout protection is already applied to individual I/O operations (listing 30s / scan 60s), but this enables monitoring of overall processing time and anomaly detection

## [2.52.0] - 2026-03-01

### Added

- **CJK encoding fallback chain** -- Introduced 10-stage fallback for ZIP filename decoding: UTF-8 → CP932 → EUC-JP → ISO-2022-JP → EUC-KR → CP949 → GB2312 → GBK → Big5 → CP950. Consolidated `try_decode()` / `repair_cp437_name()` in `core/infra_core/encoding.py`. chardet not used (fixed-order approach adopted since short filenames yield inaccurate results)
- **scan_errors table (Migration v24)** -- Persistently records encoding errors, timeouts, and FS errors during scanning to DB. Error type classification (encoding / timeout / scan / archive_scan / archive_timeout / filesystem), resolved flag, path and detail information
- **Scan error query API 3 endpoints** -- `GET /api/scan-errors` (list, filter, count limit), `POST /api/scan-errors/<id>/resolve` (mark resolved), `POST /api/scan-errors/clear` (bulk delete resolved)
- **MCP `get_scan_errors` tool** -- Queries scan errors by error type, resolved state, and count

### Changed

- **ZIP encoding detection enhancement** -- `zip_support_core.py` now tries `ZIP_METADATA_ENCODINGS` (cp932, euc-jp, gbk, euc-kr, big5) sequentially, using the first successful encoding for filename lists. Major improvement from the previous single CP932 specification
- **7z filename repair improvement** -- `sevenz_support_core.py` uses `encoding.py`'s `repair_cp437_name()` for multi-candidate recovery from CP437 mojibake
- **File enumeration error resilience improvement** -- Added `on_error` callback to `scanner_io.py`'s `iter_files()` / `iter_files_with_zips()`. Skips PermissionError/OSError per individual file on NAS/UNC/Samba paths, records errors to DB while continuing scan
- **Scan loop error recording** -- `runtime_execute.py` auto-records each file error during scan to `scan_errors` table (auto-classified type: timeout / scan / archive_timeout / archive_scan)

## [2.51.0] - 2026-03-01

### Fixed

- **Fixed bug where ZIP/7z filename 2-byte character processing stops scanning** -- `zipfile.ZipFile()` hangs on blocking I/O when reading central directory of old ZIPs encoded in Shift-JIS (CP932). Uses Python 3.11+ `metadata_encoding='cp932'` parameter to correctly decode Shift-JIS ZIP filenames. CP437 fallback included
- **Added timeout protection to ZIP/7z operations** -- Introduced daemon thread-based timeouts for counting phase `list_images_in_zip()` (30s) and scanning phase `get_mtime/get_size/extract_metadata/read_bytes` (60s). One file on a slow drive or broken archive no longer stops the entire scan
- **Added archive enumeration progress display to counting phase** -- Added `on_archive` callback to `iter_files_with_zips()`, displaying the currently processing archive name in job status during ZIP/7z listing. Visualizes which ZIP is causing a bottleneck

(オリジナル).zip` to be split at the wrong position. Lightweight path that only computes hashes without metadata re-extraction

## [2.49.5] - 2026-03-01

### Fixed

- **Fixed file contamination issue due to Japanese Windows path aliases** -- On Japanese Windows, `C:\ユーザー` exists as a hidden junction (OS-level alias) to `C:\Users`, and `os.path.normcase()` does not resolve this, causing path comparison mismatches. Added `resolve_real_path()` helper using `Path.resolve()` to resolve junctions to canonical paths, used in both watcher root determination (`_is_under_watched_root`) and DB root display (`_match_registered_root` / `_load_registered_roots`). UNC paths (`\\wsl.localhost`, etc.) are skipped to avoid known `resolve()` issues

Sleep in `probe_filesystem` / `enumerate_with_retry` also immediately interruptible via `stop_event.wait()`

(2) Model usage statistics donut chart displays as perfect circle and too large: Constrained with `legend.position: 'right'` + CSS `max-height: 260px`. (3) Settings profile management displayed in English: Added 30 profile-related keys to `ui_runtime.en.json` / `ui_runtime.ja.json` (profile_empty, profile_create, etc.)

(2)(3) SD↔NAI conversion destroys `\[literal\]` `\(literal\)`: Created protect/restore utilities in `sd_nai_convert_escape.py` and applied to all conversion functions in `sd_nai_convert_engine.py` + `sd_nai_convert_emphasis.py`. (4) Autocomplete dropdown blocks Send to Bridge button: AC dropdown (z-index:50) overlapped button row; added `position:relative; z-index:60` to `.sim-action-row` and instant hide on mousedown outside dropdown. (5) NAI Bridge generated WebP metadata not detected by fallback: Added NAI WebP fallback for Comment+Description chunks to `scanner_regular_meta_fallbacks.py`. Added `{}` remnant removal to cleanup regex. (2) Pillarboxing on vertically-oriented images in Favorites thumbnails: Changed `object-fit: contain` → `cover`. Weakening `[]` also numericized. SD `((text))` = 1.21x → NAI `1.21::text::` (was: `{{text}}` = 1.1025x with 8.9% error)

(2) Resolution statistics empty: Removed unnecessary `JOIN templates` from `RESOLUTION_STATS_SQL`, aggregating from `files` table only. Added `detail.modal.favorite` dictionary entry. (B) Fixed section silently hidden when no resolution data; now displays "No resolution data available" message. (C) i18n-ized 8 hardcoded strings in theme manager (`manager-ui.ts`) via `window.tr()`. (D) Added 12 unregistered dictionary entries to en.json/ja.json for API Keys settings tab, scan roots drag hint, collection UNION search
- **Fixed stats page "Model Usage Statistics" showing all Unknown** -- `MODEL_STATS_SQL` was parsing `Model:` text from `raw_prompt` but was A1111-specific. Changed to directly use `tm.model_name` column (set at scan time for all formats)
- **Fixed stats page "Resolution Trends" being empty** -- `RESOLUTION_STATS_SQL` was parsing `Size:` text from `raw_prompt` but was A1111-specific. Changed to calculate resolution from `files.width/height` columns (added in migration 3)
- **Fixed Settings scan tab and API Keys tab stuck at "Loading..."** -- Added `settings:tab-shown` custom event that detects unloaded tabs on tab switch and reloads data
- **Fixed Prompt Simulator SD→NAI conversion removing `[tag]` brackets** -- `convert_sd_to_nai()` was misidentifying `[tag]` as A1111-specific and unconditionally removing it. Since `[tag]` is a shared SD/NAI weakening syntax, changed to preserve brackets
- **Fixed Prompt Simulator analysis results retaining old content after input changes** -- Added `clearAllSections()` call at execution of each operation function (Simulate, Convert, DP Analyze, Weight Calc, Parse) to clear old results from other sections
- **Fixed Settings server status LAN IP not conveyed to screen readers** -- Set `aria-label` with plain text of IP address. Added long IP wrapping (`word-break`, `overflow-wrap`)
- **Fixed stats page "Model Usage Statistics" donut chart abnormally large** -- Chart.js donut chart expanded to 1:1 (square) without `aspectRatio` specified. Set `aspectRatio: 2` to match other chart sizes (BUG-03)
- **Fixed stats page "Generation Trends" line chart Y-axis scale inappropriate** -- Y-axis was drawn in narrow range when data is sparse. Added `beginAtZero: true` (BUG-04)
- **Fixed autocomplete not closing on Enter in search field** -- Enter handler required `e.shiftKey`; changed to select highlighted candidate + close dropdown on regular Enter when dropdown is visible (BUG-01)
- **Fixed Esc clearing search query while search field focused** -- vim.ts Esc handler conflicted with autocomplete Esc. Added `e.defaultPrevented` check so vim handler does not blur when autocomplete consumes Esc (BUG-02)
- **Fixed "Sort order" UI displaying duplicated** -- Both condition chip and select box were displaying. Skipped sort key chip rendering, showing only field area select (UX-01)
- **Fixed `/api/jobs/status` polling frequency too high** -- Changed fixed 2-second setInterval to adaptive setTimeout. Active jobs: 2 seconds, idle: 15 seconds (UX-05)
- **Fixed result count text line-breaking** -- Added `white-space: nowrap` to `.results-count` (UX-03)
- **Fixed many English strings untranslated in Japanese UI** -- Applied `data-i18n` / `tr()` to Collections tab, Folders tab, folder filter placeholder, selection mode buttons (Select/Select All/Deselect/Add to Favorites/Remove from Favorites/Add to Collection/Done), Grid Controls title, Extensions (nav/settings/tools), Dismiss button, Positive:/Negative: labels on result cards, Generation Parameters/Positive Prompt section headings in detail modal. Fixed Japanese translation for `settings.tab_extensions` to correct term (i18n)
- **Fixed detail modal stuck at persistent loading spinner** -- `startViewTransition` callback is asynchronously executed, so in fast environments like localhost, already-rendered modal content was overwritten by the callback's spinner. Awaits `transition.updateCallbackDone` to guarantee View Transition callback completion. Added try/catch to keyboard.ts wrapper. Moved error log before requestSeq guard in catch block
- **Fixed header PNG/WebP statistics always showing 0** -- Was hardcoding `data.sources.a1111_png`, but NovelAI v4 etc. return under `novelai_v4_png` key. Changed to aggregate all keys with `_png`/`_webp` suffix via `Object.entries()`
- **Defensive fix for stats page "Resolution Trends"** -- Fixed potential AttributeError from `.strip()` when `row[1]` is None in `_build_resolution_timeline()`. Added frontend `all.resolutions` undefined guard
- **Fixed file search HTTP 500 error** -- Fixed `services_file_search.py` referencing `t.fmt` (non-existent column) to `t.format`. Also fixed response `r["fmt"]` to `r["format"]`
- **Fixed translation key `conditions.toggle.more` / `conditions.toggle.close` exposure** -- Added missing keys to i18n en.json / ja.json
- **Fixed SQLite REGEXP function error** -- Fixed 500 error when using `REGEXP` in collection filters etc. Registers `con.create_function("REGEXP", 2, _sqlite_regexp)` in `get_db()`
- **Fixed sort condition chip label not syncing with select box** -- Added `renderActiveConditions()` call to `renderSelectField()`'s `sortBy` / `csvExportLimit` `onchange`
- **Fixed keyboard shortcut help not displaying** -- `hideKeyboardHelp()`'s `startViewTransition` wrapper blocked display on unsupported browsers. Removed `startViewTransition` since CSS already has fade-in animation
- **Fixed Esc key clearing search text** -- vim.ts Esc handler was calling `clearInput()`; changed to `el.blur()`. Esc now only removes focus from input field
- **Fixed search state and result count not translated on language switch** -- Search page empty state messages ("No images matching conditions", etc.), hint text, adaptive messages, result counts ("0 results", etc.) remained in original language after language switch. Added mechanism to `state.ts` to track last search state/count i18n spec, with auto-re-rendering on `i18n:changed` event. Targets: `state.ts`, `core.ts`, `runner-core.ts`, `runner-results.ts`, `pagination-load-more.ts`, `union-search/index.ts`
- **Fixed dark mode toggle not working in Safari** -- Object-form call of `document.startViewTransition()` throws TypeError in Safari 18+, preventing theme switching. Added 3-stage fallback: object form → callback form → direct application
- **Resolved server-info API duplicate calls** -- nav.js (`lock-visibility.ts`) and index-app.js (`server-info.ts`) were separately fetching `/api/server-info`. Cached nav.js response to `window._cachedServerInfo` for index-app.js to reuse on initial load. Polling continues with fresh fetch
- **Added user guidance when searching with empty DB** -- When displaying search results with 0 files, shows "No images in database yet" message with link to settings page instead of "No results matching conditions". Improves user flow during first-time setup
- **Windows cp932 subprocess UnicodeDecodeError fix** -- Fixed all 9 locations where `subprocess.run(text=True)` lacked `encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"`. Resolved output decoding failures for ffprobe/pip/git/node on non-UTF-8 locales including Japanese Windows (cp932), Korean (euc-kr), Chinese (big5/gb). Targets: `media_ffprobe_executor.py`, `webm.py`, `tagdb_media_webm.py`, `media_ffprobe_state.py`, `startup_build.py` (2 locations), `extensions_api_git_helpers.py`, `extensions_admin.py` (2 locations)

### Improved

- **Bridge Auto-import (DB auto-registration)** -- Added `auto_import` option to all 3 Bridges (SD WebUI / ComfyUI / NAI). Auto-registers images to DB on save (via `scan_one_regular`). Default ON. "Auto-register to DB on save" checkbox placed in Settings section. Common logic consolidated in `core/bridge_core/bridge_import.py`
- **Bridge notifications unified to toast** -- Switched all settings save, validation, and error notifications from `alert()` to `window.showToast()` across SD WebUI Bridge / ComfyUI Bridge / NAI Bridge (18 locations). Unified to consistent non-blocking UX with other pages
- **Scan root deletion UX improvement** -- On trash button press, button disabled + row fade for processing visual feedback. Toast notification on completion ("Removed: folder name (N records purged)") + immediate DOM row removal. Button restored + error toast on failure. `alert()` abolished
- **Folder tree SSE instant sync** -- Index page sidebar folder tree auto-updates on `scan_roots_changed`/`scan.complete` SSE events. Disconnects when tab hidden, auto-reconnects on return for resource conservation. Expand/selection state preserved
- **API rate limiter rebuilt to 3-tier design** -- 3 tiers: HEAVY (~20 req/min: similar search, hash computation, AI analysis, scan), DESTRUCTIVE (~12 req/min: purge, hard-delete, cache clear, config write, scan-roots DELETE), WRITE (~120 req/min: other POST/PUT/DELETE). Read GETs unlimited. Resolves thumbnail grid 429 cascade during LAN sharing while preventing destructive operation spam
- **Added file_ids limit (500) to annotations/batch-delete** -- Added limit to batch delete API that had no size restriction, preventing mass deletion attacks
- **View Transitions API comprehensive introduction** -- Added smooth transitions to all UI components. Cross-document page transition crossfade, theme toggle circular reveal, search result staggered cards, modal/overlay appearance animation, tab switching, sidebar collapse, floating panels, hamburger menu, similar images panel (slide-in), search condition menu, regex dock (slide-up), KB detail accordion, rating star bounce. Full `prefers-reduced-motion` support, non-supporting browsers use fallback
- **Bridge generated image display size optimization** -- Limited generated image height to `max-height: 50vh` so history grid is always visible even from page top. Click for full-size view (existing fullsize overlay). Added tooltip "Click for full size"

### Added

- **AI Agent Integration design guide (Phase 0)** -- Added design direction document to `docs/development/development_docs/` for future AI agent integration. Covers MCP Server support direction, API Key scope design, file_annotations table proposal, Extension Hook expansion candidates, Watcher/Hot Folder flow, and agent integration checklist
- **Batch API Standard** -- Added document standardizing batch API request/response formats. 4 principles: idempotency, partial success, explicit limits, per-item error reporting. Sync/async batch templates, scan.complete event added_ids extension specification
- **scan.complete event added_ids/updated_ids added (Phase 1a)** -- Changed scan pipeline (`scan_one_regular`, `scan_one_zip`, `scan_one_7z`) to return file IDs of new additions/updates. Collected in `execute_scan_loop`, added `added_ids`, `updated_ids`, `added_count`, `updated_count` to `scan.complete` event payload. Lists exceeding 5000 items use count only (memory protection)
- **POST /api/ratings/batch-set (Phase 1b)** -- BATCH_API_STANDARD compliant batch rating set API. 500-item limit, partial success, file existence check (is_deleted=0), validation (0-5), not_found/invalid_value/batch_empty/batch_too_large error codes
- **POST /api/collections/\<id\>/batch-add (Phase 1c)** -- BATCH_API_STANDARD compliant batch collection add API. 500-item limit, partial success, file existence check (is_deleted=0), collection existence check, idempotent (existing entries treated as success), not_found/invalid_value/collection_not_found/batch_empty/batch_too_large error codes
- **POST /api/tags/batch-set (Phase 1d)** -- BATCH_API_STANDARD compliant batch tag add/remove API. 500-item limit, partial success, file existence check (is_deleted=0). Each item specifies tag operations with `add`/`remove` arrays. New `core/tags_core/` module, new `routes/tags.py` route
- **Cursor-based pagination (Phase 1e)** -- Added `cursor` parameter to GET /api/search. Keyset method (mtime + id) for stable paging with date/date_new/date_old sort. Offset fallback for other sorts. Added `next_cursor` field to response (null for final page). Invalid or sort-mismatched cursors safely ignored. New `core/search_api/search_cursor.py`, modified `search_params.py`/`search_response.py`/`builder.py`/`sort.py`
- **file_annotations table + API (Phase 2)** -- Generic annotation layer for storing AI agent/user analysis results. DB migration 13 creates `file_annotations` table (idempotent UPSERT with UNIQUE(file_id, source, key)). CRUD + batch operations in `core/annotations_core/`, 4 endpoints in `routes/annotations.py`: `POST /api/annotations/batch-set` (500-item limit, partial success), `GET /api/annotations/<file_id>` (source/key filter), `GET /api/annotations/search` (source/key/confidence range, limit/offset), `POST /api/annotations/batch-delete` (source+file_ids+key specification). Emits `annotation.set`/`annotation.delete` events
- **MCP Server (Phase 3)** -- Model Context Protocol server for directly operating YU AI Manager from Claude Desktop / Claude Code. `mcp_server/` package (started with `python -m mcp_server`). 14 tools: search_images, get_image_detail, get_library_stats, list_collections, find_similar, rate_images, add_to_collection, set_tags, set_annotations, get_annotations, search_annotations, delete_annotations, trigger_scan, get_scan_status. 2 resources: `library://stats`, `library://recent`. Connection configured via `YU_BASE_URL` / `YU_API_KEY` environment variables. Communicates with Claude Desktop via stdio transport
- **API Key scopes (Phase 3)** -- Added scope restrictions to API keys. 7 scopes: `read`, `rate`, `tag.write`, `collection.write`, `annotate`, `scan`, `admin`. `scopes` array specifiable at key creation (unspecified = full permissions, backward compatible). Scope verification executed after Bearer auth in `check_auth`, insufficient permissions rejected with 403. GET requests always permitted (read is implicit). New `core/web/apikey_auth/key_scopes.py` (scope definitions, path→scope mapping, verification functions), modified `key_store.py`/`key_routes.py`/`auth_routes.py`
- **API Keys settings tab + MCP connection snippet** -- New API Keys tab in Settings page. Key list (prefix/label/scopes/last_used), creation form (label + 7 scope checkboxes), one-time raw key display + copy button on creation, key deletion. MCP Server (Claude Desktop) section enables one-click copy of `claude_desktop_config.json` snippet, linked with API Key select. New `src/ts/settings-page/apikeys-ui.ts`, modified `_header_server.html`/`_tabs_misc.html`/`settings.css`/`index.ts`

- **Star Rating (1-5)** -- Feature to set 1-5 star ratings on files. DB migration 12 formalizes `file_ratings` table and `phash` column. Backend CRUD (set/get/batch/stats) in `core/ratings_core/`, API endpoints in `routes/ratings.py` (`/api/ratings/set`, `/api/ratings/get`, `/api/ratings/batch`, `/api/ratings/stats`). Search filters (`min_rating`/`max_rating`) and sorts (`rating_desc`/`rating_asc`) integrated into query builder. Frontend interactive star widget (`src/ts/ratings/`), mini stars for card display, CSS added. 8 tests
- **pHash similar image search** -- API (`GET /api/tools/find-similar?file_id=N&threshold=5`) that detects similar images by pHash hamming distance from one reference image. Core logic in `core/tools/similar_find.py`, route handler in `routes/tools_api/similar_ops.py`. Frontend displays results in modal side panel (`src/ts/similar/`), clicking navigates to target image
- **Right-click context menu** -- Right-clicking grid cards shows context menu. Supports 15 operations: detail view, prompt copy (4 formats), favorite toggle, rating set (submenu), Bridge send (3 types), PL save, similar search, QR share, path copy, AI analysis. Keyboard navigation (Up/Down/Enter/Escape), submenu expansion, viewport overflow prevention. `src/ts/context-menu/` (3 files) + CSS

### Security

- **CSRF protection (X-Requested-With header method)** -- Added mandatory `X-Requested-With` header to all POST/PUT/DELETE API endpoints. Global `fetch` interceptor (`src/ts/nav/csrf-fetch.ts`) auto-injects header to all frontend requests. Also individually added to `apiFetch` wrapper. Bearer API key auth skipped. Prevents cross-origin CSRF attacks
- **PowerShell command injection fix** -- Fixed vulnerability where `initial_dir` was directly string-interpolated into PowerShell script in `core/tools/fs_dialog.py` folder selection dialog. Changed to safely pass values via environment variable (`$env:_YU_FOLDER_INIT`). Path string sanitization also added
- **Webhook SSRF prevention** -- Added `validate_webhook_url()` to `core/webhook/webhook_config.py`. Blocks webhook URL registration/update to private IP ranges (RFC 1918, loopback, link-local, reserved). Validates IP address after DNS resolution
- **SQL injection prevention (sort.py)** -- Fixed `core/query/sort.py`'s `build_sort_clause` embedding scan_roots paths in SQL via f-string. Changed to parameterized queries with `?` placeholders. Callers (`builder.py`, `search_union.py`) also updated
- **Upload size limit** -- Set `MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH = 100MB` in Flask app factory. Rejects oversized uploads with 413 error
- **Generic API rate limit** -- Added sliding window IP-based rate limiter to `core/web/api_rate_limit.py`. Regular API: 120 req/min, heavy API (similar search, hash computation, AI analysis, scan): 20 req/min. IP entry limit of 10000 prevents memory exhaustion
- **Timing-safe `hmac.compare_digest()` for API key hash comparison** -- Replaced `==` comparison in `key_store.py`
- **Reduced exposed characters in API key mask display** -- Changed from first 8 + last 4 characters → first 4 + last 2 characters
- **Debug mode exception message restriction** -- Truncated `str(e)` to 200 characters, removed type name exposure
- **`expanduser()` removal + `~` path rejection** -- Prevents home directory enumeration in `fs_listing.py`
- **Search API limit upper bound lowered from 5000→2000** -- Restricts high-load queries
- **RateLimiter IP entry limit** -- Added MAX_IPS=5000 + stale eviction to `auth_lock_state.py`
- **`/api/server-info` remote client information restriction** -- `db_path`, `lan_ips`, `platform` etc. exposed only to local requests
- **SSE connection limit** -- Max 5 simultaneous connections per IP. Returns 429 on excess
- **Trusted Proxy Auth default IP changed to empty** -- Explicit configuration required (risk mitigation for 0.0.0.0 binding)
- **`PRAGMA trusted_schema = OFF` applied during DB restore** -- Protection from malicious virtual tables
- **`error.html` `|safe` → `|tojson` change** -- Safely serializes raw dict with `|tojson` filter

- **macOS folder selection dialog support** -- Added macOS native `osascript` (AppleScript) branch to `core/tools/fs_dialog.py`. Previously on macOS, zenity absence led to tkinter fallback, but tkinter may be unbuilt on Homebrew Python. osascript is standard on macOS, ensuring reliable operation

Added always-visible zoom minibar (−/magnification/+) enabling zoom operations even when control bar is hidden. ### Fixed

- **Modal keyboard guide not displaying at all** -- Auto-hide implementation required guide visibility condition of mouse within 120px of screen bottom AND filmstrip hidden, but filmstrip also displays in the same 120px zone leaving no opportunity for guide display. Additionally, CSS `pointer-events: none` was always applied, preventing hover events from firing. Removed hover-based show/hide logic; changed to default visible (opacity:1) on modal display + dismiss button (x) for session hide (sessionStorage), added "Show keyboard guide" global toggle (localStorage) in Settings > Appearance. For restoring after dismiss: `?` button on control bar, `H` key shortcut, toast notification on dismiss. Modified CSS 1 + TS 6 + HTML 1 + i18n 2 files

### Fixed

- **LoRA Block Weight extended format splitting issue** -- LoRA tags containing extended parameters like `<lora:name:1:1:lbw=0,0,0,1,1,1>` were being split at internal commas as tag delimiters. Added `angle_depth` tracking in Python (`smart_split_by_comma`), protected commas inside `<...>` in TypeScript (`normalizePromptOperators`), extended prompt highlight LoRA regex to `<(lora|lyco):name:params>` to display all parameters including lbw. `extract_loras` also improved to return first numeric as weight, remainder as `extra` field
- **LoRA Block Weight fragments registered as tags** -- Legacy path (`core/tagdb_prompt/parse_tags.py`)'s `smart_split_by_comma` lacked `angle_depth` tracking, causing LBW values (`0`, `0>`, `1`, etc.) to be registered as tags in DB. Added `angle_depth` to legacy path and added filters rejecting pure numeric/`>`-suffixed fragments to both `parse_candidate` functions. Existing data fixable by rescanning target folders
- **Tag `\(` `\)` parsing issue** -- Danbooru/NAI format escaped brackets `\(` `\)` had `)` disappear during orphan bracket removal in tag extraction, breaking tags like `lumine \(genshin impact\`. Added `(?<!\\)` lookbehind to `parse_candidate` regex. Also fixed `\(` being token-split in prompt highlight's `findNextSpecialIndex`
- **i18n key `result.save_to_library` undefined** -- Modal "Save to Library" button was displaying the translation key as-is. Added to `ui_runtime.en.json` / `ui_runtime.ja.json`

### Removed

- **compat alias system removal** -- Deleted `core/compat/module_aliases.py`'s `sys.meta_path` hook and 200-line alias map (`module_aliases_map.py`). Removed MetaPathFinder that was intercepting all `import` statements, normalizing import paths in 105 files to actual module paths. Also deleted `core/legacy_compat/` directory (37 files, tagdb legacy stubs). Total ~400 lines / 39 files deleted. Confirmed burn-in test (all 545 modules imported) + existing 86 tests all pass

### Fixed

- **All media becomes unloadable during fast navigation of video/audio** -- Rapidly pressing arrow keys while video/audio item is selected in modal causes browser errors from `.load()` being called on `<source>` elements remaining in DOM after src removal, with orphaned media elements exhausting HTTP connection pool making all subsequent thumbnails, images, videos, and audio unrenderable. Fixed 3 locations: (1) `releaseMediaElement` completely removes `<source>` from DOM, (2) `showDetail()` calls `releaseModalMedia()` before innerHTML replacement during navigation, (3) added 120ms throttle to `navigateModal()`
- **Custom theme not applied on other pages** -- `nav/theme.ts` was only applying `themeMode` (dark/light) without restoring custom themes (preset/user-defined). Additionally, page-specific bundles (index/stats/story/tools/inspect) had legacy theme initialization overwriting CSS variables applied by `nav.js` custom theme. Added custom theme restoration to `nav/theme.ts` and added `getActiveThemeId()` guard to 5 legacy initializations. Confirmed correct theme application on all 6 pages via Playwright
- **Settings page theme QR export not displaying** -- `qrcode.min.js` was only loaded in `index.html`; on settings page, QR library was undefined showing fallback text. Added same vendor script tag (with CDN fallback) to `settings.html`

### Added

### Fixed

- **Inspect/Scan: ComfyUI WebP metadata not parsed** -- `extract_comfyui_json()` could not detect workflow JSON stored in ComfyUI WebP's EXIF UserComment. Added `exif:UserComment` key to search targets with ComfyUI pattern detection. Applied strict mode that adopts only when matching numeric keys, `class_type`, or `nodes` to prevent false positives
- **Inspect: Raised analysis quality to modal equivalent (P1 complete)** -- Fixed `window.escapeHtml is not a function` error (added escapeHtml etc. 10 functions to bundle via `inspect-page/globals.ts`). Improved to return NovelAI V4 `novelai_v4` structured payload via Extension on_inspect hook. Fixed character position grid not rendering (changed to preferentially reference `raw_meta_json`, avoiding `raw_metadata.Comment` 2000-character truncation issue). E2E verified for all 5 formats: A1111 PNG/WebP, NovelAI V4 PNG/WebP, ComfyUI
- **Inspect: Raised analysis capability to modal equivalent** -- Added weight, namespace, and ORDER BY to tags, included raw_meta_json in response, and displayed NovelAI V4 character prompt cards (base caption, per-character prompts, negative, Vibe Transfer) on inspect page. CSS also added
- **Inspect: NAI V4 WebP metadata not displaying** -- In `extract_chunks_for_file()`, NAI WebP's EXIF UserComment (valid JSON) was not expanded into `chunks` dict, causing extension hook to early-return on empty chunks. Fixed to expand keys to chunks on successful JSON parse
- **Inspect: NAI WebP raw metadata display empty** -- `extract_raw_metadata()` was only reading `img.info` for WebP without retrieving EXIF UserComment. Added EXIF fallback
- **Bridge: Previous parameter restoration not working** -- Not auto-restored on page load, requiring manual button click. Fixed to execute auto-restore after `loadConfig()` completes. Skips on prompt receipt via Send to Bridge. Error logging also added
- **Bridge: Danbooru tag completion not displaying** -- PromptSyntaxWidget's `.ps-editor-wrap` with `overflow: hidden` was clipping the autocomplete dropdown. Fixed `ensureDrop()` to traverse up the DOM tree and place dropdown in parent container without overflow clipping
- **Bridge: Text area shrinking with each input** -- `updateEditorLayout()` was setting `textarea.scrollHeight` directly to `wrap.style.height`, but under global `* { box-sizing: border-box }` reset, the wrap's border (2px) caused a feedback loop shrinking the inner area each time. Corrected by adding border width

### Improved

- **Added filename / folder columns to CSV export** -- Both search result CSV (client-side) and collection CSV (server-side) now auto-separate `path` into `filename` and `folder` for output. Column order: `id, filename, folder, path, meta_source, mtime, positive, negative`. Facilitates organization and filtering in Excel etc.

### Added

- **Bridge: Previous parameter restore button** -- Added "Previous" button to all 3 Bridges (SD WebUI / NAI / ComfyUI). Auto-saves text parameters to localStorage on successful generation, all parameters restored on button click. Targets prompt, negative, Steps, Sampler, CFG, W/H, Seed, etc. NAI Bridge also saves unique parameters like Model, Noise Schedule, Quality Toggle. Common logic created as new `BridgeLastParams` TypeScript module
- **Bridge: Seed reset button** -- Added dice button next to Seed input field on all 3 Bridges. One-click reset of Seed to -1 (random)

- **Auto dependency resolution at startup** -- Auto-detects updates to `requirements.txt` and `src/ts/` before server startup, executing `uv pip install` and `node build.mjs` as needed. Prevents forgotten manual builds after `git pull`. Only warns and continues startup when `uv`/`node` not installed
- **SD WebUI Bridge: img2img support** -- Supports img2img generation based on existing images. Added collapsible section below Negative Prompt (image drop zone + Denoising Strength slider). Button label switches to "img2img Generate" when image is set. API auto-determines txt2img/img2img by presence of `init_images`
- **Bridge 2-column layout + generation history panel** -- Implemented left: controls / right: generated image + history 2-column layout for all 3 Bridges (SD WebUI / NAI / ComfyUI). Right panel shows latest generated image large with history thumbnail grid (4 columns) for reviewing past images. Responsively switches to 1 column at 768px or below. - **Bridge: Generate button moved to top** -- Moved Action buttons + Progress bar to directly after prompt input on all 3 Bridges. Generate button accessible without scrolling

## [2.26.0] - 2026-02-24

### Added — API Extension Phase 1 (RESTful + Webhook)

- **Event Bus** (`core/event_bus/`): Thread-safe in-process pub/sub — all subsystem events flow through a single `EventBus` singleton
  - `Event` dataclass with type, timestamp, data, source
  - 8 event types: `scan.start/progress/complete/error`, `favorite.add/remove`, `collection.create/delete`
- **API Key Authentication** (`core/web/apikey_auth/`): Bearer token auth bypassing PIN session
  - `POST/GET/DELETE /api/apikeys` — key CRUD (PIN session required)
  - Key format: `sk_` + 32 hex (128-bit), stored as SHA-256 hash in config.json
  - Per-key sliding window rate limiter (120 req/min)
- **SSE (Server-Sent Events)** (`core/sse/`): Real-time event streaming
  - `GET /api/events/stream` — SSE endpoint with optional `?types=` filter
  - Per-client queue fan-out, 30s heartbeat, max 256 queued events per client
- **Webhook** (`core/webhook/`): HTTP POST callback with HMAC signing + retry
  - `POST/GET/PUT/DELETE /api/webhooks` — webhook CRUD (PIN session required)
  - `POST /api/webhooks/<id>/test` — test event delivery
  - `GET /api/webhooks/deliveries` — delivery history log
  - HMAC-SHA256 signature (`X-Webhook-Signature`), 3 retries, ThreadPoolExecutor dispatch
  - DB delivery log with 7-day auto-purge on startup

### New files (17)
- `core/event_bus/__init__.py`, `bus.py`, `event_types.py`
- `core/web/apikey_auth/__init__.py`, `key_store.py`, `key_auth.py`, `key_routes.py`
- `core/sse/__init__.py`, `broadcaster.py`, `sse_routes.py`
- `core/webhook/__init__.py`, `webhook_config.py`, `webhook_dispatcher.py`, `webhook_delivery_log.py`, `webhook_routes.py`

### Changed — Architecture Health Improvements (3 items)

- **DB connection pool**: Introduced `threading.local` based connection pool in `core/services_core/db_state.py`. Reuses connections within the same thread, reducing `connect` + PRAGMA issuance cost per request
- **Silent exception → logging.debug**: Replaced 30 instances of `except Exception: pass` in `core/` with `logging.debug()`. Enables error cause tracing during debugging (3 intentional instances excluded)

## [2.21.27b] - 2026-02-23

### Fixed — PromptSyntax/WC Manager: Highlight and textarea perfect sync fix

- **Fixed text wrapping offset due to scrollbar width mismatch**: Removed scrollbar-hiding CSS (`scrollbar-width: none`, `::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none }`) from WC Manager's `.ps-highlight`. Content width differed by ~15-17px between highlight and textarea, causing wrapping positions to misalign and colors appearing on wrong lines after line 18. Since highlight is behind textarea at z-index: 1, the scrollbar is naturally hidden by the textarea's scrollbar
- **Fixed cursor/selection offset due to font mismatch**: `.wm-editor textarea` (specificity 0,1,1) was overriding `.ps-textarea` (0,1,0), so textarea resolved to `font-family: monospace` (browser default = Courier New etc.) while highlight used `'Consolas',...,monospace`. Added explicit font stack to `#wmEditorContainer .ps-textarea` (specificity 1,1,0) to unify. Also added `font-family: inherit` to `.ps-highlight span`
- **Fixed form control rendering differences**: Added `appearance: none`, `-webkit-text-size-adjust: none`, `font-kerning: none` to `.ps-textarea`. Also added `font-kerning: none` to `.ps-highlight`. Eliminated browser default style differences between textarea and div
- **Fixed ghosting (afterimage)**: Changed synchronous `void highlight.offsetHeight` + immediate `scrollTop` setting in `update()` to `requestAnimationFrame` based. Now syncs scroll position after layout calculations (including scrollHeight) are fully resolved
- Target files: `wc_manager_parts/_style.html`, `prompt-syntax-style-base.css`, `prompt-syntax-widget-editor.js`

## [2.21.27] - 2026-02-23

### Fixed — PromptSyntax: Highlight layer line height drift + editing ghosting + SD/NAI EMPHASIS invisible

- **Fixed line height drift + cursor position offset**: Added reset of all layout-affecting properties to `.ps-highlight span` (`font-weight: inherit; padding: 0; margin: 0; border: none; letter-spacing: inherit`). `font-weight: 700` brackets subtly changed line height causing highlights to drift from textarea in 252-line files making colors appear to "disappear", and `.ps-sd-w { padding: 0 1px }` horizontally shifted cursor position — both issues resolved simultaneously. Only color, background, and text-decoration are allowed; all layout-affecting properties are reset to inherit/0
- **Fixed editing ghosting**: Forced synchronous reflow with `void highlight.offsetHeight` after `updateEditorLayout()` in `update()`. Resolved issue where browser set `scrollTop` before reflow completed, causing inaccurate scroll position
- **SD_EMPHASIS visualization**: Added `background: rgba(255, 204, 102, 0.06)` to `.ps-sd-em`. Now distinguishable from plain text on dark backgrounds
- **NAI_EMPHASIS visualization**: Added `background: rgba(180, 120, 255, 0.06)` to `.ps-nai-em`. Resolved same invisibility issue
- Target files: `prompt-syntax-style-base.css`, `prompt-syntax-style-sd.css`, `prompt-syntax-style-nai.css`, `prompt-syntax-widget-editor.js`

---

## [2.21.26] - 2026-02-23

### Fixed — PromptSyntax: `\(` `\[` `\{` escaped brackets cause parse errors wiping colors for all subsequent lines

- **Cause**: When `\(` appeared at the tokenizer's top level, `findTextEnd` consumed `\` as text, then stopped at the next `(`. The bare `(` triggered `matchParen` → `findMatchingClose`, which skipped `\)` as escape while scanning all remaining text. If no matching `)` was found, an ERROR token was generated; if found, a massive token spanning hundreds of lines was created — in either case, syntax coloring for all subsequent lines was completely lost
- **Fix**: Added escaped bracket handling to `findTextEnd()`. When `\` + any of `()[]{}` is detected, both characters are consumed together as text, preventing them from being passed to the bracket matcher
  - Target file: `prompt-syntax-engine-core-lex-matchers-general.js`
  - Escape processing inside `findMatchingClose` (skipping `\(` `\)` within bracket expressions) works correctly as-is
- **Impact**: Wildcard files in WC Manager (e.g., `__characters_genshin_impact__`) contain many entries with `\(genshin impact\)` in character names, and opening such files caused all colors to disappear after a certain line

## [2.21.24] - 2026-02-23

### Fixed — WC Manager: Content not updating / no colors when selecting large files

- `extensions/builtin_prompt-simulator/templates/wc_manager_parts/_script.html`: Fixed large file path in `_wmSetValue()`
  - **Cause**: Performance optimization skipped `_wmEditor.update()` for files over 1000 lines, but `.ps-textarea` has `color: transparent !important` making it fully transparent, so users only see the `.ps-highlight` div content. Not calling update() left the previous file's HTML in `.ps-highlight`, causing (1) content not switching and (2) syntax colors remaining from previous file
  - **Fix**: Even for large files, set `hlDiv.textContent = v` on the highlight div to show plain text. Expensive tokenization is still skipped, but displayed content now switches correctly

## [2.21.23] - 2026-02-23

### Fixed — Server becomes unreachable after Windows restart

- `core/web/restart_routes.py`: Changed `os.execv()` on Windows to `subprocess.Popen` + `os._exit` approach
  - **Cause**: `os.execv()` on Windows spawns a new process then kills the old one, so the new process tries to bind the port before the old socket is released, causing failure
  - **Fix**: Created `_exec_restart()` helper. On Windows, launches independent process with `subprocess.Popen(CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP)` then terminates old process with `os._exit(0)`. On Unix, maintains existing `os.execv` behavior
  - Applied to both restart API (`/api/server/restart`) and profile switch (`/api/server/switch-profile`)

## [2.21.22] - 2026-02-23

### Fixed — WC Manager Editor Blank Line Bug (Brave / Chromium)

- `extensions/builtin_prompt-simulator/templates/wc_manager_parts/_script.html`: Fixed (F) in `_wmSetValue()`
  - **Cause**: When performance optimizations (A)/(B) replaced `execCommand` with `textarea.value = v`, `scrollTop` was not reset. The previous wildcard's scroll position persisted, displaying the new content from the middle and showing blank lines.
  - **path (A) small files**: Reset wrap height first with `wrap.style.height = ''` → allows `updateEditorLayout` to calculate correct height for new content
  - **path (A) / (B) common**: Added `editorTa.scrollTop = 0` to reset scroll position to top
  - **Fallback**: Also added `ta.scrollTop = 0` to plain textarea
  - **Gutter**: Explicitly reset `window._wmGutter.scrollTop = 0` (not relying on asynchronous scroll event firing)

## [2.12.1] - 2026-02-21

### Security — Security Hardening (Full Review Response)
- Strengthened PIN hash from single SHA-256 to PBKDF2-HMAC with 600,000 iterations
- Changed PIN comparison to `hmac.compare_digest()` (timing attack countermeasure)
- Added CSRF token validation to PIN form
- Added `secure=True` to `pin_token` cookie (when using HTTPS)
- Made `--pin` required when binding to `0.0.0.0` (startup refused without it)
- Added localhost-only guards to dangerous endpoints: `list-dirs`, `backup-download`, `restore`, `extensions/install`, `extensions/update`, `extensions/uninstall`
- Restricted extension installation git URLs to https/http only (blocking `ext::`, `file://`, `ssh://`)
- Added path traversal validation for extension repository names (`is_relative_to` check)
- Added dangerous directive validation for `requirements.txt` (rejecting `--index-url`, direct URL specifications, etc.)
- Added path traversal validation during ZIP extraction (using `zf.extract()` return value + `realpath` check)
- Rejecting .db files containing triggers/views during DB restore
- Removed server absolute paths from DB restore responses

## [2.9.0] - 2026-02-21

### Added — Background Thumbnail Preload on All Pages
- Created new `static/js/shared/background-preload.js` loaded on all pages
  - Continues thumbnail generation on non-search pages (Stats/Story/Tools/Settings/Inspect/Extensions/Share)
  - `sessionStorage('thumbPreloadDone')` persists completion state across page navigation
  - `sessionStorage('groupsIndex')` group index also shared across all pages
  - Existing preloader takes priority on search page, sharing completion flag
  - Dynamic progress bar displayed directly below navbar (on non-search pages)

### Added — Group Index Rebuild Feature
- Added ↻ refresh button next to group buttons on search page
  - Force rebuilds server-side `groups_index.json` → clears client-side cache → re-preloads
  - Manual recovery tool when group display is incorrect after scan or DB changes
- Server API: Added `POST /api/tools/rebuild-groups`
- Server-side ZIP groups: Include ZIP containers with only 1 file as groups (`min_members=1`)

### Fixed — Group Display Empty After Rebuild
- Fixed `_fetchGroupsIndex` race condition in `_rebuildGroups`
  - Old: `_startBackgroundPreload()` called `_fetchGroupsIndex` first, and the outer call returned immediately
  - New: `_fetchGroupsIndex` returns the in-progress Promise, properly awaited
- Rebuild flow: ① Fetch group index → ② Display results → ③ Thumbnail preload (async)
- Button re-enabled during rebuild without waiting for preload completion (since user explicitly requested)

### Changed — Enhanced Folder/ZIP Button Graying
- Folders/ZIP buttons disabled until BOTH group index fetch AND thumbnail preload are complete
  - Old: Enabled immediately after group index fetch (even if preload incomplete)
  - New: `_enableButtonsIfReady()` gate function checks both conditions
- Resolved issue where pressing button during preload had no response

### Fixed — Modal Navigation Crossing ZIP/Folder Boundaries
- Fixed issue where pressing → key after opening modal from ZIP/folder mode container card would navigate to files in a different ZIP/folder
  - Old: ZIP container click used `openContainerViewForFile` (async API call), causing race condition in scope setting
  - New: Both ZIP and folder use synchronously precomputed member IDs directly, no API call
- Fixed `navigateModal` to explicitly pass `scope` and `scopeIds` when calling `showDetail`
  - Old: `showDetail(nextId)` — implicitly resolved scope from external state
  - New: `showDetail(nextId, { scope, scopeIds })` — explicitly carries over current scope and IDs
- Random display (`openRandomResult`) also fixed to explicitly pass scope

### Fixed — Modal Filmstrip Not Displaying
- `modal-filmstrip.css` was not included in `modal.css`'s `@import`
- CSS addition now correctly displays the thumbnail list at the bottom of ZIP/folder modals

### Fixed — ZIP Categorization Showing Even with Only 1 File in Results
- ZIP groups: Now display as container card even when search results contain only 1 file
  - Old: Excluded when `filtered.length < 2` → New: ZIP only skips when `filtered.length === 0`
  - Folder groups still require 2+ files as before
- Container card member IDs and counts displayed using server-side total members
  - Clicking fetches all members via `/api/container-members`, maintaining consistency

### Added — Stats/Story Page Server-Side Cache
- Stats/Story API responses cached server-side on disk (`cache/stats_cache.json`, `cache/story_cache.json`)
  - Cache validity determined by `file_count` + `max_mtime`, only rebuilds on DB changes
  - Uses same cache pattern as `groups_index.py`
- New unified API: `GET /api/stats/all` — Returns 5 Stats results in 1 response
  - Fetches `basic`, `hourly`, `timeline`, `models`, `resolutions` in bulk
- Existing individual endpoints (`/api/stats`, `/api/stats/hourly`, etc.) also share the cache
- Client side: Consolidated 5 serial fetches into 1 `/api/stats/all` call (reduced round trips)
- Story API (`/api/stats/story`) also cache-enabled

### Added — Modal Thumbnail Filmstrip
- Displays all member thumbnails as a ticker at the bottom of ZIP/folder modal
  - Single-row horizontal scroll, 56×56px, currently displayed image has highlight border
  - Click to jump instantly, auto-scroll follows on ←→ key navigation
  - Position indicator (`3 / 128`) displayed
  - `loading="lazy"` for smooth operation even with hundreds of images
- Replaced old `container-representatives` (4-image fixed strip) with filmstrip

### Added — Server-Side Group Index Cache
- Folder/ZIP group structure calculated server-side and cached in `cache/groups_index.json`
  - Cache validity determined by `file_count` + `max_mtime`, only rebuilds on DB changes
  - Cache reused across sessions and browser restarts (no recalculation each time)
- New API: `GET /api/groups-index` — Returns cached group index
- Rewrote `/api/container-thumb-ids` to share group index (removed logic duplication)
- Client side: Groups cached in `sessionStorage`, eliminating API calls on page navigation
  - Grouping by intersection with search result IDs (faster than DOM path traversal)
  - Group mode available without waiting for thumbnail preload completion

### Added — Container (ZIP/Folder) Inter-Group Navigation
- Added feature to automatically transition to next/previous group at endpoint images in folder/ZIP modal display
  - Default OFF, enabled via settings page toggle (`containerNavContinuous` localStorage)
  - Two navigation order options: name order (natural sort) and search result order (`containerNavOrder`)
- Persisted group order lists (`_orderedGroups` / `_resultOrderGroups`) in `runtime-results-grouping.js`
- Public API `getAdjacentGroupIds(currentIds, delta)` to get adjacent groups

### Fixed — i18n (Internationalization) Comprehensive Fix
- Fixed modal keyboard hint bar being fixed to Japanese (redraws on language switch)
- Metadata renderer: i18n-ized hardcoded Japanese for Copy (SD/NAI format) buttons, Dynamic expansion buttons, etc.
- Metadata file info: i18n-ized 7 locations including directory display, checkpoint search, Seed copy, etc.
- Detail modal controls: i18n-ized operation toasts and tooltips for Resume/Repeat/Mute/Speed, etc.
- Search modal: Added `data-i18n` attributes to placeholders, buttons, option labels, hint text
- Search form: Added i18n support for `<option>`/`<optgroup>` elements (added `data-i18n-label` attribute support to `i18n-core-shared.js`)
- Container view: i18n-ized alert messages
- Server info: i18n-ized files/tags labels and uptime display
- Condition builder: Unified Japanese fallback labels to English
- Header: i18n-ized statistics toggle button tooltip and aria-label

- Fixed issue where search API requests enter infinite loop when switching to folder/ZIP mode
  - Blocked loop where card hiding makes IntersectionObserver sentinel visible → loadMore → re-render → visible again
  - Tears down scroll observer during group mode, re-sets up on return to all mode
- Fixed ←→ arrow buttons/arrow keys not working for navigation in modal
  - Fixed issue where `applyToCurrentResults()` was overwriting modal scope IDs
  - Skips `modalDetailState.setResultIds` during `folder_only`/`container_only` scope

- Regex intro modal: i18n-ized all text (15 keys added)
- Regex cheat panel: i18n-ized entire guide, items, and header controls (60+ keys added)

## [2.8.0] - 2026-02-20

### Added — Stability, detection, and diagnostics
- Boot state readiness: `/api/server-info` now includes `boot_state` field; frontend gates auto-search until server is ready.
- APNG/animated WebP detection: backend chunk analysis (`acTL`/`ANIM`) with `is_animated` flag in `/api/file/<id>` response.
- Error page QR diagnostics: HTML error pages now display a QR code with error/status/path/version for easy sharing.
- Model name extraction improvements: ComfyUI `UNETLoader` support, tensor.art fallback keys, path stripping, `.pt`/`.pth`/`.bin` extensions.
- Media preference persistence: volume, mute, and playback rate saved to localStorage across media views.
- Global keyboard shortcuts on all pages (`/` for search, `L` for lock).
- Error page i18n support via Accept-Language header detection.

### Fixed — Critical bugs
- SQLite `database is locked` resolved with `timeout=5.0` + WAL + `synchronous=NORMAL`.
- Firefox long-idle freeze fixed by switching server-info polling to visibility API.
- NAI↔SD conversion: `[word]` bracket stripping, weighted mixing roundtrip, pipe-to-AND protection.
- NAI V4 QR share: negative prompt reconstructed from `raw_meta_json` when `raw_negative` is empty.
- Scan cancel now clears persisted interrupted-state.
- Static PNG/WebP no longer misclassified as animated images.
- Merge conflicts resolved in modal media/controls modules.

### Changed — Documentation and quality
- Documentation hub (`docs/README.md`) restructured around consolidated `ALL_IN_ONE.md`.
- README updated with v2.8.0 release notes and fixed documentation links.
- Console logging improved with contextual messages in i18n and scan modules.
- ZIP error diagnostics enhanced with variant counts and entry samples.
- A1111 modal display filters redundant params (Model hash, VAE hash, Version).

## [2.7.2] - 2026-02-18

### Added — Modal playback and result grouping (2026-02-19)
- Detail modal keyboard controls were expanded for media playback: `k`/`Space` play-pause, `j`/`l` seek, `m` mute, `[`/`]` volume, `<`/`>` speed, `0` restart.
- Added modal playback controls UI (play/pause, rewind, speed cycle, resume-mode toggle) and persisted per-file audio/video resume positions.
- Added grouped result display modes on search page (`Files` / `Folders` / `ZIP`) with page-level toggle and persisted selection.
- Added new tests for container natural sort, dialog output decoding fallback, and AI-only stats filtering.
- Added `docs/development/UI_BUTTON_PRIORITY_GUIDELINES.md` to codify GC-controller-style button hierarchy (frequent/assist/rare tiers).

### Changed — Navigation and stats behavior
- Modal now consumes `PageUp` / `PageDown` for in-modal navigation to avoid moving background result index while viewer is open.
- Scan progress banner positioning/z-index was adjusted so the fixed top navigation remains operable.
- Stats endpoints were switched to AI-image-focused aggregation (non-AI image rows and media-oriented sources excluded from generation stats).
- ZIP container member ordering now uses natural sort semantics to avoid `1, 10, 11, 2` ordering.
- Condition chips now show concise value summaries (text/select/toggle/period/resolution) to improve scanability.
- File format condition now supports per-extension filtering via `format_exts` (UI checkboxes + search API/SQL wiring).
- Added i18n keys for extension-filter UI labels (`conditions.format.ext_*`) in Japanese/English runtime dictionaries.

### Fixed — Platform/UX issues
- Native folder picker cancel now returns quietly without showing a false failure alert.
- Windows folder-picker subprocess output decoding now handles CP932 safely to avoid `UnicodeDecodeError` in metadata/scan workflows.
- Folder/ZIP grouped result mode now synchronizes modal navigation scope to visible cards to prevent hidden-entry traversal.
- `pin_boss_login_ui` now accepts explicit string booleans (`"false"`, `"off"`, etc.) in addition to JSON booleans to prevent unintended boss-login enablement.
- Added null-guards in condition rendering to avoid intermittent runtime errors when condition DOM nodes are absent during UI transitions.
- Resetting the file-format condition now clears `format_exts` too, preventing stale extension filters from remaining active.
- `format_exts=zip` now maps to ZIP-member path pattern (`%.zip!%`) instead of plain suffix matching.
- Prompt tag parser now honors `prompt_syntax` (`nai`/`sd`/`auto`); `nai` mode treats `()` as literal instead of SD-style implicit weight.
- Unified API response envelope helpers were introduced (`api_result` / `api_success`) and applied across major route groups while preserving legacy top-level keys.
- Added query-parameter alias normalization helper (`core/infra_core/api_params.py`) and applied it to search/suggest/tools file-search/stats timeline (`q/query`, `limit/n`, `offset/skip`, etc.).
- Extended API unification to search and extensions endpoints (response envelope + alias-aware extension payload parsing).
- Stats endpoints were migrated to the unified API envelope (`api_result`) for consistent success/error shape.
- Added `core/infra_core/api_request.py` and started unifying JSON body reads via `get_json_dict()` across major POST APIs.
- Added strict JSON-body validation helper (`require_json_dict`) and applied it to JSON-required endpoints with explicit `invalid_content_type` / `invalid_json` / `invalid_json_object` codes.
- Normalized ZIP sub-API internals (`routes/zip_files_api/*`) to return payload/status consistently (removed mixed Response-return paths).
- Added shared validation helper (`core/infra_core/api_validation.py`) and applied it to scan/scan-roots mutation/runtime paths.
- Expanded alias handling for extensions/restart/scan-roots payloads and standardized payload error codes to snake_case across major API helpers.
- Fixed startup 500 under PIN auth when `render_pin_page`/`render_lock_page` signature mismatched by adding backward-compatible fallback calls in `core/web/auth_routes.py`.

### Changed — Condition chip summary
- Format condition chips now include selected extension summary (e.g. `.png,.webm`) for quick visibility.

### Changed — Modularization sprint
- Split `core.extractors.media_ffprobe` into constants/normalize/state/executor modules and kept the thin public facade while updating all consumers (media detail resolver, services, scans) to the new structure.
- Pushed schema helpers into dedicated SQL/migration/version modules for both `core/schema_core` and `core/tagdb_core/db_schema`, added README callouts, and kept the public `init_db`/`migrate_db` entrypoints.
- Broke `routes/files_api/detail_payload`, `routes/scan_roots_api/routes_config`, `core/query/filters_common`, and `core/compat/module_aliases` into handler/data modules so each facade now re-exports lightweight helpers.

### Testing
- Startup smoke (`python web_ui.py --db tags.db --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8093` + `curl /` → 200)
- `pytest -q tests/test_basic.py`
- `pytest -q tests/test_browser.py -k "test_page_loads"` (skipped by design)
- Added basic regression tests for PIN boss/classic page rendering and auth setup boolean parsing.

### Docs
- Audited TODO status against implementation and reclassified media-related items:
  - video format expansion and video thumbnail generation marked done,
  - detailed per-extension filter UI retained as a remaining task.
- Added API response policy doc: `docs/development/API_RESPONSE_GUIDELINES.md`.

- **Startup behavior setting inconsistency**: Fixed restore (preserve) mode performing auto-search
  - auto: Restore conditions + auto-search, restore: Restore conditions only, clear: Clear conditions + empty search
  - Return from page navigation auto-searches regardless of mode (scrollY detection)
- **Accurate total count in results**: COUNT version query for `100 / 23456 results` format

### Changed — Architecture
- **Extension HTML delivery**: Transitioned from ext_htmls custom convention → Flask Blueprint approach
- **DP editor direction**: Decided on CodeMirror 5.x integration instead of custom editor
- **Template unification**: Unified nav across 8 pages to `_nav.html` include + `active` variable

- **pathlib → os.path switch**: Avoid pathlib bugs with WSL UNC paths

### Fixed — QR Sharing

- **Fallback for files without metadata**: 404 → return basic info (has_metadata: false)

## Upgrade Notes

### From v2.5.x to v2.5.4
- File overwrite only (no DB changes, but automatic re-scan due to PARSER_VERSION=3)
- Force re-scan recommended (for ZIP internal V4 metadata fix)

### From v2.2 to v2.3
- No manual action required
- Automatic migration on startup
- WebUI will show notification if re-scan recommended

### From v2.0-2.1 to v2.3
- Run: `python tagdb_tool.py init --db tags.db`
- Or just start WebUI (automatic migration)

### From v0.x-v1.x to v2.3
- Backup your database first
- Run: `python tagdb_tool.py init --db tags.db`
- Recommended: Full re-scan for best results

---

### v2.0.0
- Introduced schema versioning
- Old databases need migration (automatic)

### v1.0.0
- Added new required columns (model_name, model_hash)
- Migration required
